name: hwde
description: KiCad hardware design: ihsan-sa/hwde's PCB design skill as a Hive module. An agent takes a board from a written brief through research, architecture, parts, schematic, placement, routing and checks (ERC, DRC, the verify suite, JLCPCB DFM on exported Gerbers) to a fab package; its checks are tools the agent runs and weighs, and it brings the person only what is theirs (error waivers, cost/feature trades, the order). It runs no program of its own: bin/hwde runs the skill's scripts in the agent's own sandbox with the Hive's KiCad 10 and freerouting from the shared tools folder and a Python venv in the agent's HOME. It never orders or pays: ordering at JLCPCB, or any purchase, stays the person's.
